'''''Pycnocomon''''' is a genus of [[flowering plant]]s belonging to the family [[Caprifoliaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=''Pycnocomon'' Hoffmanns. & Link {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:14325-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=27 May 2021 |language=en}}</ref> They were formerly placed in the defunct family of [[Dipsacaceae]].<ref name=Avino2009/>

It is native to the [[Mediterranean]] and found in the countries of Algeria, Corsica, Greece, Italy, Morocco, Portugal, Sardinia, Sicily, Spain and Tunisia.<ref name="POWO" />

It was first published in Fl. Portug. vol.2 on page 93 in 1820.<ref name="POWO" />

It was included in genus ''[[Scabiosa]]'' {{au|L.}} for a long time but molecular data demonstrated that genera ''Pycnocomon'' and ''[[Lomelosia]]'' (another Scabiosa-like genus) form a [[clade]] distinct from ''Scabiosa''.<ref name=Avino2009>{{cite journal |last1=Avino |first1=M. |last2=Tortoriello |first2=G. |last3=Caputo |first3=P. |title=A phylogenetic analysis of Dipsacaceae (Dipsacales) based on four DNA regions. |journal=Pl. Syst. Evol. |date=2009 |volume=279 |pages=69–86|doi=10.1007/s00606-009-0147-y }}</ref>

In 2017, a new species from the family [[Eriophyidae]], the gall mites, ''[[Aceria pycnocomi]]'' was found on ''Pycnocomon rutifolium'' in Spain.
<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ripka |first1=Géza |last2=Sánchez |first2=Iñigo |title=A new ''Aceria'' species (Acari: Eriophyidae) from Spain on ''Pycnocomon rutifolium'' (Dipsacaceae) and supplementary descriptions of ''Aceria eucricotes'' and ''A. kuko'' from ''Lycium'' spp. (Solanaceae) |journal=Zootaxa |date=March 2017 |volume=4244 |issue=2 |page=195 |doi=10.11646/zootaxa.4244.2.2|pmid=28610119 }}</ref>

''Pycnocomon rutifolium'' in Spain was screened for Anticancer activity in 2021.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Calderón-Montaño |first1=José Manuel |last2=Martínez-Sánchez |first2=Sara María |last3=Jiménez-González |first3=Víctor |last4=Burgos-Morón |first4=Estefanía |last5=Guillén-Mancina |first5=Emilio |last6=Jiménez-Alonso |first6=Julio José |last7=Díaz-Ortega |first7=Patricia |last8=García |first8=Felipe |last9=Aparicio |first9=Abelardo |last10=López-Lázaro |first10=Miguel |title=Screening for Selective Anticancer Activity of 65 Extracts of Plants Collected in Western Andalusia, Spain |journal=Plants |date=October 2021 |volume=10 |issue=10 |page=2193 |doi=10.3390/plants10102193 |pmid=34686002|doi-access=free |pmc=8537044 }}</ref>
